## HaloBar 0.0.7

### New
- **Starfall.** Following Astraeus' theme now brings its night sky to the dock, the top bar and every panel: fine star dust, soft edge light and a violet glow that drifts while you hover and rests in place otherwise, so idle stays free.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
